author: rozaru
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN001157886

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Men (Q9VG31, D.melanogaster)

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
erroneous propagation of mitochondrion CC term to Men
Man has been shown experimentally to be in cytosol and not in mitochondria
title: PAINT issue: PTN001157886 erroneous propagation of mitochondrion CC term to Men (Dmel)

author: rozaru
body:
I am sorry Marc I realised that there was another paralog CG7848 (Q7K3R0) for which the paint annotation to mitochondrion is also erroneous. Would you be able to remove the annotation for this gene too?
Thanks

author: marcfeuermann
body: No worries. I made the correction. The family tree is quite complex. I've removed mitochondrial annotation from a little node containing the 2 Drosophila sequences as well as a Anopheles sequence.
